# B4 gap attribution — sefer vs mimalloc (generated by scripts/b4_gap_attribution_table.mjs v2)

Methodology v2: callgrind --toggle-collect=gp_kernel_probe::kernel_* (window inside the core kernel function only);
time_ratio = exp(ab_median), judge J1 (Windows) = mi/sefer; Ir/EstCycles ratios = mi/sefer (WSL, marginal p80-p40 per op).
EstCycles is the callgrind cost model (Ir + 10*(D1mr+D1mw+I1mr) + 100*(LLmr+LLmw+ILmr) + 10*Bcm), NOT hardware. ИЗМЕРЕНО unless noted.
Classification thresholds (0.1 / 0.7) were fixed by the owner/orchestrator BEFORE the measurements; this script (v2) was written AFTER
the first (full-process-window) iteration — iteration history in docs/perf/B4_GAP_ATTRIBUTION.md.
